title: 第156章 可惜可叹
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她的语气很冷，但没有杀意。

只是单纯的怀疑。

一个沉睡了四千年的人，醒来之后面对一群完全陌生的人，有怀疑是再正常不过的事。

张瑀没有反驳。

他转过身，看向季伯渊。

季伯渊会意，往前走了两步，抱拳行礼，声音郑重到了极点：“陆宗主，老朽天符宗宗主季伯渊。”

“我等今日在此

“苍玄界已经过去了四千年。”

他顿了顿，语气变得更加沉重。

“但也是自从天裂之变后，苍玄界再也没有了化神期的修士，甚至连元婴期的修士都极少。天裂之变前，苍玄界可谓无比鼎盛，而今早已不复当年。”

陆清寒听完，沉默了良久。

她的目光在季伯渊身上停了很长时间，又扫过在场的每一个人。

她在判断这些人有没有在撒谎。

季伯渊的表情很坦然，眼神没有闪烁。

二长老、三长老、女长老——所有人的表情都是同样的坦然。

他们都是修行了上百年的人物，心性早已修炼得足够沉稳。

再说了，在这种事情上撒谎，没有任何意义。

终于——

陆清寒开口了。

她的声音比刚才更轻了几分。

“天剑宗呢？”

就四个字。

但这四个字一出来，在场所有人的心都沉了一下。

季伯渊张了张嘴，没有说话。

二长老低下了头。

三长老避开了目光。

张瑀看着陆清寒，缓缓开口：“天剑宗，已经全宗覆灭了。”

陆清寒的身体微微晃了一下。

但所有人都看到了。

她那双一向凛冽如刀的眼睛里，终于有了一丝明显的波动。

那不是愤怒，不是悲伤。

是某种更深沉的、无法用言语形容的东西。

像是在冰封了数千年的湖面上，忽然裂开了一道口子。

她沉默了良久。

然后她开口了。

声音很轻，像是自言自语。

“一个都没剩下吗？”

张瑀没有说话。

季伯渊也没有说话。

没有人回答这个问题。

因为答案，她心里已经知道了。

陆清寒闭上了眼睛。

当她再睁开眼睛的时候，那双深黑色的眼睛里已经恢复了平静。

Page (1/3)

Her tone was cold, but not murderous.

Just pure suspicion.

It is normal for a person who has been sleeping for four thousand years to have doubts when he wakes up and faces a group of complete strangers.

Zhang Yu did not refute.

He turned around and looked at Ji Boyuan.

Ji Boyuan understood, took two steps forward, clasped his fists in salute, and said in an extremely solemn voice: "Sect Master Lu, Ji Boyuan, the Patriarch of the Old Decay Tianfu Sect."

"I'm waiting here today

“Four thousand years have passed in the Cangxuan Realm."

He paused and his tone became heavier.

“But also since the Sky Splitting Incident, there are no longer any monks in the Divine Transformation Stage in the Cangxuan Realm, and there are even very few monks in the Nascent Soul Stage.Before the Heavenly Splitting Incident, the Cangxuan Realm was extremely prosperous, but today it is no longer what it used to be."

After Lu Qinghan listened, he was silent for a long time.

Her eyes stayed on Ji Boyuan for a long time, and then scanned everyone present.

She was trying to decide whether these people were lying.

Ji Boyuan's expression was calm and his eyes did not flicker.

The second elder, the third elder, the female elder—all of them had the same calm expressions.

They are all people who have been practicing for hundreds of years, and their minds have long been cultivated to be calm enough.

Besides, there is no point in lying about this kind of thing.

Finally——

Lu Qinghan spoke.

Her voice was a little softer than before.

“Where is Tianjian Sect?"

Just four words.

But as soon as these four words came out, the hearts of everyone present sank.

Ji Boyuan opened his mouth but said nothing.

The second elder lowered his head.

The third elder avoided looking.

Zhang Yu looked at Lu Qinghan and said slowly: "The Tianjian Sect has been completely destroyed."

Lu Qinghan's body shook slightly.

But everyone saw it.

There was finally a clear fluctuation in her eyes, which had always been as sharp as knives.

It's not anger, it's not sadness.

It's something deeper and indescribable.

It was as if a hole suddenly opened in the lake that had been frozen for thousands of years.

She was silent for a long time.

Then she spoke.

The voice was very soft, like talking to himself.

"Are there not any left?"

Zhang Yu said nothing.

Ji Boyuan didn't speak either.

No one answered this question.

Because she already knew the answer.

Lu Qinghan closed his eyes.

When she opened her eyes again, calm had returned to her dark black eyes.
